goal: Prevent descriptor wallets from missing transactions and reporting incorrect balances during rescans
Fixes cases where a transaction beyond the look-ahead pool precedes a pool-expanding transaction in a block
reviewability: Review logic now, mechanical rebase needed on master
agreement: Concept approval for fixing the lookahead rescan bug despite scanning blocks twice (achow101)
Nonblocking objection: prefix rescan misses later child spends and leaves parent unspent (molnard)
Nonblocking objection: cascading receives past scan_end are missed, leaving balance short (jeanpablojp)

directly violating wallet recovery correctness when transactions in the same block expand the keypool
